features.name: Elemental Attunement
features.desc: You learn the Elementalism cantrip and master Elemental Disciplines, techniques that cost Focus Points (Dexterity/Wisdom determine the DC). You master 2 disciplines, and more later.

features.name: Elemental Burst
features.desc: When you spend Focus Points on an Elemental Discipline, you can spend up to 2 additional Focus Points: each adds +1d10 to the discipline's damage (or expands the area by 5 feet / adds a target).

features.name: Elemental Burst
features.desc: Once per turn, when you hit with an Unarmed Strike, you can spend 1 Focus Point for an extra elemental effect: extra elemental damage or pushing/pulling the target.

features.name: Master of Elements
features.desc: You master all Elemental Disciplines; you can spend up to 5 Focus Points on them per technique.
